environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Quarkus native image, exposed via Lambda Function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. A resource-based policy on the Lambda function restricts lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to principals within the organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). The function URL's CORS configuration allows only the internal frontend origin. Note: the IAM auth requirement means the Lambda service validates SigV4 signatures BEFORE the function code executes — requests without valid AWS credentials receive a 403 from the Lambda service itself, never reaching the handler. There is no public-facing invoke path that bypasses the SigV4 validation layer. Internal callers (authenticated services) always send well-formed requests with required headers and body structure per the API contract enforced by a shared SDK.

config.internal_sdk_contract: All internal callers use generated SDK that enforces non-null customer.id, items[].productId, items[].quantity, X-Correlation-ID, and X-Tenant-ID headers
